io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.variants

Class VariantGroup

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.variants.VariantGroup

  • public final class VariantGroup
extends java.lang.Object
    An ordered set of SlimefunItems that are the same thing in different flavours - one part shape in every material, one machine in every tier - and that the guide should therefore show in a single slot instead of one slot each.

    Every member stays a fully registered SlimefunItem with its own id, recipe and research; grouping changes only how the guide presents them.

    See Also:
    VariantGroupRegistry
